b2b_price_lock_enabled.label: Enable price lock
b2b_price_lock_enabled.info: Prices, price filters, add to cart and checkout are only available to logged-in customers with the tag below.

b2b_price_customer_tag.label: Customer tag
b2b_price_customer_tag.info: Customers with this tag can see prices, e.g. B2B. Not case-sensitive. If left empty, logging in is enough.

b2b_price_lock_message.label: Message for visitors without access
b2b_price_lock_message.info: Shown in the lock box instead of the price on the product page, in quick add and instead of the checkout button in the cart.

b2b_price_lock_login_url.label: Login button link
b2b_price_lock_login_url.info: If left empty, the button links to the shop's login page.

b2b_price_lock_register_url.label: Registration button link
b2b_price_lock_register_url.info: If left empty, the button links to /pages/b2b-registration. Should differ from the login link.
